summary: Haleon plc filed a Form 6-K reporting ordinary share purchases under its buyback program announced 12 March 2026. Between 1-5 June 2026, the company purchased 16,585,448 shares for cancellation across multiple venues at weighted-average prices from ~319.9p to 334.1p per share. Post-settlement, total voting rights are 8,830,688,844 shares. The program reduces outstanding share count and returns capital to shareholders. Watch for continued buyback pace and any program expansion or completion announcements in future updates.
